title: .NET Technology Relationship Standard
subtitle: Comprehensive specification of .NET architecture, data access, logging, security, messaging, testing, and deployment integration.

coreTechnology.usage: Database access menggunakan ORM, LINQ, migration
Query SQL manual berkinerja tinggi & reporting

architectures.name: Repository + Service
architectures.description: Pola berlapis memisahkan Controller (HTTP), Service (Business Logic), dan Repository (Data Access).
architectures.suitability: Aplikasi dengan struktur sederhana sampai menengah.

components.name: Service
components.role: Menangani core business logic dan validasi aturan bisnis

components.name: Repository
components.role: Menangani isolasi akses database via EF Core / Dapper

architectures.name: Clean Architecture
architectures.description: Dependency inversion dengan Domain sebagai pusat, direkomendasikan untuk sistem kompleks dengan siklus hidup panjang.
architectures.suitability: Aplikasi enterprise, domain logic rumit, butuh testability dan maintainability jangka panjang.

layers.content: Commands, Queries, Use Cases, Service, DTO, FluentValidation
Entities, Value Objects, Enums, Domain Exceptions & Business Rules
EF Core DbContext, Dapper, Repositories, External API, Message Publisher

efCore.title: Entity Framework Core
whenToUse: Membutuhkan ORM lengkap dengan Change Tracker
Menggunakan entity dan complex navigation relationships

dapper.title: Dapper (Micro ORM)
whenToUse: Performa query kritis dengan latency minimal
Mapping object sederhana langsung dari hasil SQL
dapper.relationship: Service ➔ Repository ➔ Dapper ➔ SQL Query ➔ Database

hybrid.title: EF Core + Dapper (Hybrid Approach)
hybrid.guideline: Gunakan EF Core sebagai default untuk CRUD dan relasi entitas. Gunakan Dapper untuk reporting atau query berat yang membutuhkan optimasi SQL manual. Hindari penggunaan 2 ORM untuk tabel yang sama tanpa kebutuhan yang jelas.

validation.flow: Controller ➔ Request DTO ➔ FluentValidation ➔ Service ➔ Business Logic
guidelines: Input Validation: Validasi format, required field, numeric range, string length, regex.
Business Validation: Validasi aturan bisnis di service layer (misal cek saldo, unik nama produk).
Database Constraint: Validasi integritas tingkat database (foreign key, unique constraint).

logging.flow: Controller ➔ Service ➔ Repository ➔ Serilog ➔ Log Storage / Monitoring
minimalScopes: Request metadata (Method, Path, CorrelationId, Duration, Status)
Error / Unhandled Exception dengan stack trace
sanitizationRules: Dilarang mencatat Password, Secret Key, Token JWT, Refresh Token
Dilarang mencatat PII sensitif (Nomor KTP, Nomor Kartu Kredit)

technologies.name: JWT Bearer Authentication
technologies.desc: Stateless token validation dengan custom claims

auth.flow: Client ➔ API ➔ Authentication Middleware ➔ JWT Validation ➔ Authorization Policy ➔ Controller

simple.useCase: Task asynchronous internal sederhana tanpa kebutuhan retry schedule UI

advanced.useCase: Scheduled job, cron, retry mechanism, job history, delayed execution, dashboard monitoring

backgroundJobs.flow: Application ➔ Background Worker ➔ Service ➔ Repository / External Service

technologies.name: RabbitMQ
technologies.fit: Backend-to-backend communication, worker queues, event-driven architecture

technologies.name: MQTT
technologies.fit: IoT devices, lightweight telemetry, high connection density

technologies.name: Azure Service Bus
technologies.fit: Enterprise cloud messaging dengan enterprise queue guarantees

messaging.flow: Application ➔ Publisher ➔ Message Broker ➔ Consumer / Worker ➔ Service

testing.scope: Real isolated database instance dalam Docker

containerization.flow: .NET Application ➔ Multi-stage Dockerfile ➔ Container ➔ Docker Compose / Container Platform

deployment.flow: Git Repo ➔ CI/CD (GitHub Actions/GitLab) ➔ Docker Image ➔ Linux VM ➔ Docker Container
Git Repo ➔ CI/CD ➔ Container Registry ➔ Kubernetes Cluster ➔ Pod / Service

sources: Secret Manager / Azure Key Vault / HashiCorp Vault (Production secrets)
configuration.rule: Secret seperti database password, JWT secret, dan API key tidak boleh dicatat langsung di source code.
